title: Products
fed_pending_desc: Base products approved by the assembly of other federated nodes. For them to be available on this node, the local assembly must approve them individually.
pending_desc: Products that have been requested but have not yet been approved for the catalog. Approve them so they appear in the main list.
form_badge_placeholder: Ex: Fresh Today, Star Dish, 100% Pure
form_badge_hint: Label that appears highlighted on the product card on the public page.
form_visibility_hint: Hiding does not delete the product, it just removes it from the public page.
tooltip_allow_node: Allow this product on the node
tooltip_disallow_node: Do not allow this product on the node
tooltip_promote_base: Promote to base product (appears across the federation)
tooltip_propose_to_base: Propose in Assembly to convert to base product
tooltip_propose_disapprove: Propose to disapprove this product in the Assembly
tooltip_propose_approve: Propose to approve this product in the Assembly
tooltip_propose_delete: Propose to DELETE this product in the Assembly (permanent)
success_disapprove_proposal: Proposal created in the Assembly to disapprove "{{name}}". The Assembly or Board of Directors will decides.
success_approve_proposal: Proposal created in the Assembly to approve "{{name}}". The Assembly or Board of Directors will decides.
success_delete_proposal: Proposal created in the Assembly to delete "{{name}}". Requires Assembly approval.
success_import_proposal: Proposal created in the Assembly to import "{{name}}". The Assembly will decides whether to approve it.
success_remove_proposal: Proposal created in the Assembly to remove "{{name}}".
success_to_base_proposal: Proposal created in the Assembly to convert "{{name}}" to base product.
success_allowed: "{{name}}" marked as allowed on the node.
success_disallowed: "{{name}}" marked as NOT allowed on the node.
store_composite_desc: Create a new product by selecting raw materials, base products, work hours, packaging and shipping from the approved catalog. The price is calculated automatically. No assembly approval needed because it uses already-approved components.
store_product_name_placeholder: Ex: Orange juice 200ml, Whole wheat bread, My jam
store_category_location: Place your product in its exact category (3 levels)
store_location_required: You must select at least parent category and category. If you need a new category, ask administration to create it in the catalog.
store_description_placeholder: Describe your product: how you make it, what makes it special...
store_add_components_desc: Select raw materials, base products, work hours, packaging or shipping. The price is calculated automatically.
store_add_catalog_desc: Select a product from the global registry and indicate how many units you have available.
store_no_products_registry: There are no products in the registry. The assembly must add products first.
store_extra_costs_desc: For shipping or special presentation. If the buyer picks up at your place, leave at 0.
store_extra_desc_placeholder: Ex: Returnable glass jar, home delivery
store_empty_hint: Add products from the global registry with the button above.
store_browse_desc: Explore all products available in the community. Each product shows who sells it and its price.
store_try_clear: Try clearing the filters or searching for another term.
store_products_appear: Products appear when members add them to their stores.
store_component_search_placeholder: Type the component name... (ex: orange, clay, fabric, container)
store_no_results_search: No match for "{{term}}" in this category
store_no_results_category: No components available in this category
store_no_results_hint: Try another word or change category. If the component does not exist, ask administration to add it to the catalog.
store_session_expired_hint: If your session expired, save your work and log in again.
error_yield_zero: The number of products that come out must be greater than zero
error_name_required: You must give your product a name
error_category_required: You must select the parent category and the category of your product
error_components_required: You must add at least one component
error_select_product: Select a product from the registry
help_what: Each user has its propia tienda where ofrece them products that has available for intercambiar. Is as your vitrina personal: muestras that tienes and other can verlo and comprarlo. Your tienda is independiente of them demas.
help_purpose: Sirve for that each member gestione its inventario personal. Indicas that products of the catalogo comunitario tienes available and in that quantity. Asi other members saben a who acudir for conseguir it that search.
help_usage: 1) Ve a My Tienda and presiona Add Product. 2) Selects a product of the catalogo comunitario. 3) Indica cuantas unidades tienes (stock). 4) The product appears in your tienda with its price fijo.
help_add_label: As add products of the catalogo a your tienda:
help_add: Only puedes sell products that already exist in the record global. If necesitas a product that no this, must aprobarse in assembly first.
help_stock: Is it quantity of unidades that tienes available for sell. When someone compra, the stock decreases automaticamente.
help_price: The price is fijo and comes of the record global of products. No puedes cambiarlo: the same product cuesta it same in all them tiendas.
help_sale: When someone finds your product and it compra, itself transfiere the monto of its account a it tuya, and the stock itself reduce.
help_my_store: Shows them products that your ofreces and your inventario personal.
help_search: Searches that products estan available in all them tiendas of it network.
help_federation_desc: All them products base that exist in all it network of nodes federated, INCLUYENDO them of your propio node. Aqui puedes view all them products and decidir cuales estan permitidos or no permitidos in your node.
help_my_node_desc: Them products base that pertenecen a your aldea. Has two sub-pestanas: Permitidos (products that can be sell/use) and No Permitidos (products explicitamente prohibidos). Puedes editarlos, create new, and moverlos between permitido and no permitido.
help_compounds_desc: Products creados by it people of your aldea combinando products base (ej: harina + agua = pan). If all them ingredientes already estan permitidos, the compuesto appears directly aqui without necesidad of aprobacion.
help_search_desc: Escribe part of the name in the field of busqueda for find products rapidamente.
help_public_page_desc: Them products aprobados appear automaticamente in it pagina publica if usas the bloque Catalogo from Backend.
